d: Jet black hair is styled in a long, sleek cut with blunt bangs and a single thick, ornate braid adorned with gold ornaments. The eyes are a vivid crimson with a gentle, smiling expression on a youthful, teenage face. The build is slender and fit, dressed in a white sleeveless top paired with a short, pleated red skirt and matching red thigh-high socks, all partially covered by a flowing white cloak. Large, black mechanical battleship riggings featuring cannons and armored plates are mounted on the back and shoulders.
